notFoundDescription: The dashboard you're looking for does not exist or has been removed.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view this dashboard.

gallery.title: Widget gallery

viewMode.label: Run dashboard as
viewMode.individualHint: Each person sees only what they have access to, so numbers can differ from person to person.
viewMode.initiativeHint: Everyone sees the same numbers, with full read access to this initiative — regardless of their own permissions. Use with caution.
viewMode.notAllowed: Your role can't run dashboards as Initiative. An initiative manager can turn it on, or allow it for your role.
